answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in thread and cedar lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the sonnet graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1053 impostors cost 1142 times the honest price and take 24 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
